description: We are analyzing space fire data for our project.
summary: MS-IGNITION is a web-based space fire safety and combustion physics platform engineered to visualize, analyze, and simulate spacecraft fire dynamics using authentic NASA microgravity experimental data. In weightless environments, the absence of buoyancy-driven thermal convection prevents hot gases from rising, causing flames to form unique symmetrical spherical geometries—a phenomenon demonstrated by NASA’s FLEX and Saffire flight experiments. MS-IGNITION translates complex aerospace combustion datasets into an accessible digital laboratory featuring an interactive Microgravity Fire Risk Analyzer, a 3D Spacecraft Fleet Simulator, a Historical Mission Data Room (Apollo 1, Apollo 13, and Mir incidents), and an embedded NASA-Grounded Rule-Based Chat Assistant. Accessible via standard phone or desktop browsers, MS-IGNITION allows users to manipulate cabin parameters such as oxygen percentage, airflow speed, and Limiting Oxygen Index (LOI) against official NASA safety thresholds, bridging raw space agency research with actionable safety insights for future crewed space missions.
details:
How It Works & Functional Architecture
MS-IGNITION visualizes and evaluates flame behavior under weightless conditions by integrating validated flight data from NASA open resources (PSI, NTRS, NASA Glenn, and NASA Spinoff pages).
Physical Simulation & Risk Analyzer: Users adjust environmental variables including ambient oxygen concentration (21%–22% ISS operational baseline), forced ventilation speeds (10–30 cm/s matching Saffire experimental parameters), and material Limiting Oxygen Index (LOI). The simulation calculates flame propagation risks and flags hazardous conditions when parameters breach NASA safety standards.
3D Spacecraft Fleet Simulator: Built using Three.js, the simulator provides interactive 3D renderings of spacecraft cabin architectures, enabling users to inspect internal layout zones and evaluate microgravity fire safety configurations.
Data Export & Reporting: Integrates jsPDF to allow users to generate downloadable PDF diagnostic reports summarizing cabin risk analyses directly within their web browser.
Historical Incident & Spinoff Data Room: Synthesizes historical spacecraft fire events (Apollo 1, Apollo 13, Mir) alongside NASA Spinoff fire mitigation technologies, transforming static historical reports into interactive risk models.
Benefits & Real-World Impact
Democratizing Space Physics: Complex combustion equations and experimental data from FLEX and Saffire are converted into interactive visual models accessible to researchers, aerospace students, and space enthusiasts.
Enhancing Cabin Safety Awareness: Provides clear visual comparisons between terrestrial fire behaviors and microgravity spherical flames, highlighting why traditional earth-bound fire suppression systems fail in weightlessness.
Cross-Platform Accessibility: The web-based tool runs seamlessly across desktop and mobile browsers, ensuring worldwide educational access.
Tools & Technologies Used
Platform Architecture: Entirely web-based application running directly in any mobile or computer web browser.
Core Web Stack: Standard web deployment utilizing HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript. The first version used React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS (built on Bolt).
Graphics & Document Libraries: Three.js for 3D models; jsPDF for client-side PDF exports.
AI Coding Tools: Claude (Anthropic) for writing and editing code; Bolt for initial site scaffold.
Hosting & Source Control: GitHub for repository version control; Vercel for public cloud hosting.
Creativity & Innovation
Rather than presenting microgravity fire safety through static PDF reports, MS-IGNITION combines physics-grounded threshold modeling with 3D visualization, client-side PDF export, and real-time parameter tuning. It transforms "Flame in Freefall" research into an immersive, end-to-end interactive diagnostic experience
